metadata.name: ww-section
metadata.description: HTML div for flexible layout management. Requires display property in styles.

specifications: IMPORTANT: The default value for flexDirection is row
Display must be one of: block, flex, grid, inline-block, inline-flex, inline-grid, none.
Do NOT use complex gridTemplateColumns formats like `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr))` - not supported

To define responsive gridTemplateColumns, set it in desired breakpoints: `"style":{"default":{"gridTemplateColumns":"repeat(3, 1fr)"},"tablet":{"gridTemplateColumns":"repeat(2, 1fr)"},"mobile":{"gridTemplateColumns":"1fr"}}}`
